title: A GUM-style uncertainty budget for split-conformal text classification (AG News)

data.dataset: fancyzhx/ag_news (Hugging Face), parquet files data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet and data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet
data.subsets: prep_data.py, numpy default_rng(0): 2000 balanced train items; 2000 balanced test items split into a 1000 calibration pool and a 1000 test pool. Shared evaluation subset for every model = first 250 of the calibration pool and first 250 of the test pool (data/zs_set.json). Scaling test uses calibration pool items 0..499 (Clef only).
data.shift: Synthetic covariate shift: each word dropped with p=level/2, remaining words >3 chars get an adjacent swap or deletion with p=level; seed 1000+item index. Levels 0, 0.15, 0.3, 0.45 (supervised); 0.3 for the shared comparison.

clef-flash-8bit.loader: clef_mlx.py shipped with the model repo; raw option logits via ClefMLX.logits()

models.supervised_head: sklearn MLPClassifier(hidden_layer_sizes=(64,), alpha=1e-3, max_iter=300) on StandardScaler'd embeddings; reference seed 0; seeds 1..15; 15 training bootstraps (seed 0).

not_run.GLiNER2 (local DeBERTa-v3-large checkpoi: package install (gliner2[local], torch) hung for >11 min on the Mac; dropped for time.
not_run.PA_Score (Xin et al., arXiv:2610.04239): needs hidden-state access; the Clef loader and Ollama API expose only logits/logprobs. A paraphrase-ensemble analogue (mean probability over 4 wordings) is reported instead.

clef_question_phrasings.q0_topic: What is the topic of this news article?
clef_question_phrasings.q1_section: Which section of a newspaper would this article appear in?
clef_question_phrasings.q2_classify: Classify the text into one category.

prompts.llm_chat_message:
Classify the news article into exactly one topic.

Article: <text>

Topics:
A) <wording[0]>
B) <wording[1]>
C) <wording[2]>
D) <wording[3]>

Answer with a single letter (A, B, C or D) and nothing else.
prompts.llm_probabilities: First generated token: sum exp(logprob) of top-20 candidates whose stripped text is exactly A/B/C/D, renormalised over A-D (missing letters get 0; all-missing -> uniform).

w2_topic: computers, the internet and scientific research

conditions.neutral_ids_A-D: option ids A-D carry definitions (main run w2_topic|q0)
conditions.matched: option id = class name, criterion = that class's definition
conditions.swapped: name of class c bound to the definition of class (c+1) mod 4

conformal.method: split conformal, LAC score 1 - p(true class), alpha = 0.10, quantile level ceil((n+1)(1-alpha))/n with method='higher'; empty sets allowed

hardware.analysis_and_supervised: Linux x86_64 VM, 8 vCPU, CPU only
hardware.clef_and_llms: Apple Silicon M5, 32 GB unified memory, macOS 26

regenerate: python prep_data.py            # fixed subsets (seed 0) -> cache/supervised_set.json, cache/zs_set.json
python embed_box.py            # MiniLM + bge-small embeddings -> cache/emb_*.npz
python3 embed_gemma.py         # embeddinggemma via Ollama -> out/emb_embeddinggemma.npz
CLEF_DIR=<local snapshot of mlx-community/clef-flash-8bit> $MLX_PY run_clef.py; $MLX_PY run_clef_calx.py; $MLX_PY run_repeat_clef.py; $MLX_PY run_nameswap.py
python3 run_ollama.py qwen3.5:9b w0_official,w1_news,w2_topic,w3_short 1; python3 run_ollama.py qwen38-q5-fast:latest w0_official 1
python3 run_repeat_llm.py qwen3.5:9b w0_official 75 t0 4; ... default 4; ... w2_topic 25 t0 4   (see run_queue2.sh)
python repeatability.py && python budget.py && python plots.py && python gen_tables.py > tables.md

repeatability.clef: 4 identical runs; w0_official|q0: 100 cal + 100 test items; other wordings: 10 + 10
repeatability.qwen3.5_t0: 4 runs, temperature 0, seed 42; w0: 75+75 items, w2_topic: 25+25
repeatability.qwen3.5_default: 4 runs, model default sampling (temperature 1, top_k 20, top_p 0.95, presence_penalty 1.5), seeds 1000..1003; w0: 75+75
repeatability.ollama_request: /api/chat, think=false, num_predict=1, logprobs=true, top_logprobs=20; probabilities = renormalised sum of exp(logprob) over tokens equal to A/B/C/D after stripping
repeatability.cross_session: main run (separate process) vs repeatability run 0

scaling.pool: 500 calibration items (250 shared + 250 extra, Clef only, 4 wordings, q0)
scaling.sampling: bootstrap with replacement from the pool; same indices for all wordings (paired); fixed 250-item test set
